name: ammo
description: Run a staged, multi-agent campaign that profiles and optimizes Pumice inference latency on your own NVIDIA GPU host, inside a local Pumice checkout, with no server, container, or web UI. The campaign keeps the seven stages (baseline, bottleneck mining, debate, isolated implementation and validation tracks, integration, campaign evaluation), the fact-checked report, four independent audits, and five binding gates, and ships only changes that are production-active, correct, and statistically faster. Ships the lead skill (ammo:ammo), the report sub-skill (ammo:ammo-report), eight role agents (ammo:<role>), and the campaign hooks. The investigator is pave-init:adversarial-investigator from the pave-init plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Run staged Pumice latency optimization campaigns.
interface.longDescription: Profile a Pumice model on your GPU host, debate and build candidate optimizations in isolated worktrees, validate them through audits and binding gates, and write an evidence-backed report.
defaultPrompt: Start an AMMO campaign for this model and GPU target.
